Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.spi

Interface FeatureProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
FeastFeatureProvider, JdbcFeatureProvider, MonitoredFeatureProvider, RedisFeatureProvider, SlidingWindowFeatureProvider, VersioningFeatureProvider
public interface FeatureProvider
Service Provider Interface (SPI) for fetching feature values used as inference inputs.

Status: this interface defines the extension point only. It is introduced now (alongside InferenceProvider and ModelRegistry) so the runtime's plugin surface is stable and complete, but concrete implementations (Redis, JDBC, Feast, REST, Iceberg) are intentionally out of scope until the Feature Store Integrations milestone. OtterRuntime does not yet wire this SPI into the inference path.

Intended shape:


 public class RedisFeatureProvider implements FeatureProvider {
     public String getProviderId() { return "redis"; }
     public Map<String, Object> fetch(String entityId, List<String> featureNames) {
         // look up featureNames for entityId in Redis
     }
 }
Since:
0.1.0 (interface only; implementations land in a later milestone)
